t_advice_summary_textbox.text: go for the gnomes with longer arms, more colour and bigger hats. When it stops working then do the reverse.

vb_textbox.text: Do the basics right. Always chose a gnome and tap in the time given to get points. Once you find a size and colour that works then stick to it. Once it stops working move onto the opposite size and a different colour. Possibly a different method after each set such as all left or all right. Once you find a gnome with a high number then stick to the gnomes with them similarities.
